The French Revolution

1789 - 1799

The Causes of the Revolution

The French Revolution was caused by a combination of factors, including political, economic, military, and social changes. Political factors included the growing influence of Enlightenment ideals, a monarchy that failed to keep up with the changing times, and the formation of the Estates Genera
